blocks.text: try, need, help: yana uchta «ikki yuzli» fe'l

56-darsda remember, regret, stop kabi fe'llardan keyin to va -ing ma'noni o'zgartirishini ko'rdik (→ 56-dars). Bu darsda yana uchta shunday fe'l: **try** (urinmoq yoki sinab ko'rmoq), **need** (o'zim qilishim kerak yoki narsa qilinishi kerak) va **help** (yordam bermoq yoki o'zini tuta olmaslik). Ularning har birida o'zbekcha tarjima tanlovni juda aniq ko'rsatadi: «-ishga urindim» va «-ib ko'rdim», «-ishim kerak» va «-ish kerak», «yordam berdi» va «beixtiyor ...».
try to do — urinmoq, try doing — sinab ko'rmoq

**try to do** — qiyin ishni uddalashga **harakat qilish**; natija noaniq yoki muvaffaqiyatsiz: I **tried to open** the window, but it was stuck — «Derazani ochishga urindim, lekin qotib qolgan edi». **try doing** — muammoni hal qilish uchun biror usulni **tajriba sifatida** qilib ko'rish. Bu yerda harakatning o'zi oson, savol — u yordam beradimi: The room was hot, so I **tried opening** the window — «Xona issiq edi, derazani ochib ko'rdim» (ochdim, lekin foyda berdimi?). O'zbekcha qolip deyarli mukammal mos: «-ishga **urindim** / **harakat qildim**» → try to; «-ib **ko'rdim**» → try -ing.

rows: I **tried to lift** the box, but it was too heavy.
I **tried taking** a painkiller, but my head still hurt.

items.text: I **tried to move** the piano myself, but it was far too heavy.
items.translation: Pianinoni o'zim **surishga urindim**, lekin u haddan tashqari og'ir edi.

items.text: The phone wouldn't connect, so I **tried switching** it off and on again.
items.translation: Telefon ulanmadi, shuning uchun uni **o'chirib-yoqib ko'rdim**.

items.text: **Try to get** some sleep before your night shift.
items.translation: Tungi smenangizdan oldin biroz **uxlab olishga harakat qiling**.

blocks.text: need to do va need doing

**need to do** — ega o'zi nimadir qilishi kerak: I **need to tidy** my room — «Xonamni yig'ishtirishim kerak». **need doing** — **narsa** nimadir qilinishga muhtoj; ma'no majhul: My room **needs tidying** = My room **needs to be tidied** — «Xonani yig'ishtirish kerak». Bu qolipda ega — odam emas, narsa (car, room, roof, shirt), va harakatni kim qilishi muhim emas. O'zbekchada farq qo'shimchada: yuv**ishim** kerak (men) — yuv**ish** kerak (umuman). **don't need to** — «shart emas», «hojat yo'q»: You **don't need to come** (needn't haqida → 32-dars).

items.text: These trousers **need shortening** — they're far too long for me.
items.translation: Bu shimni **kaltalatish kerak** — menga juda uzun.

items.text: Do I **need to book** in advance, or can I just turn up?
items.translation: Oldindan **bron qilishim kerakmi** yoki shunchaki kelaversam bo'ladimi?

items.text: The office printer **needs fixing** again — it's printing everything in pink.
items.translation: Ofisdagi printerni yana **tuzatish kerak** — hamma narsani pushti rangda chiqaryapti.

blocks.text: Britaniya so'zlashuvida **needs doing** o'rniga ba'zan **wants doing** ham eshitiladi: The grass **wants cutting** — «Maysani o'rish kerak». Ma'no bir xil, faqat norasmiy. **try** + ot — «tatib / sinab ko'rmoq»: **Try** this soup! — «Bu sho'rvani tatib ko'ring!»

**help** dan keyin **to** ixtiyoriy: Everybody **helped (to) clean** up; She **helped me (to) carry** the bags. Kundalik nutqda to siz shakl ko'proq. **can't help doing** esa butunlay boshqa ma'no: «o'zini tuta olmaslik», «beixtiyor qilib qo'yish»: I **couldn't help laughing** — «Kulib yubordim, o'zimni tutolmadim». **I can't help it** — «Ilojim yo'q, qo'limdan kelmaydi». **can't help feeling / thinking** — «... degan fikrdan qutula olmayman». Adashtirmang: I **can't help you** — «Sizga yordam bera olmayman» (oddiy help).

rows: He **helped me (to) fill in** the form.

items.text: This app **helps you plan** your budget for the month.
items.translation: Bu ilova oylik budjetingizni **rejalashtirishga yordam beradi**.

items.text: When I saw his face, I **couldn't help laughing**.
I **can't help thinking** that something is wrong with this deal.
items.translation: Bu bitimda nimadir noto'g'ri, **degan fikr xayolimdan ketmayapti**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I tried opening the jar, but I couldn't» (qiyin ish, uddalay olmadim) → I **tried to open** the jar.; «Try to restart your computer» (maslahat — usulni sinab ko'r) → **Try restarting** your computer.; «My car needs to wash.» → My car **needs washing** / **needs to be washed**.; «I need cleaning my room.» → I **need to clean** my room.; «I couldn't help to laugh.» → I **couldn't help laughing**.; «I can't help but laugh» — Amerikacha, Britaniyada **can't help laughing** odatiyroq.

Tekshirish usuli: o'zbekcha tarjimani ayting. «-ishga **urindim**» → **try to**; «-ib **ko'rdim**» → **try -ing**. «-ish**im** kerak» (men) → **need to**; «-ish kerak» (narsa) → **needs -ing**. «Beixtiyor», «o'zimni tutolmadim» → **can't help -ing**.

rows: narsa qilinishi kerak (= needs to be done)

examples.title: **try to do**: making an effort
examples.description: Qiyin ishni uddalashga urinish — natija noaniq yoki muvaffaqiyatsiz. O'zbekchada «-ishga urinmoq / harakat qilmoq».

sentences.text: I **tried to open** the jar, but the lid was stuck.
sentences.translation: Bankani **ochishga urindim**, lekin qopqog'i qotib qolgan edi.

sentences.text: Please **try to be** on time tomorrow — the client is coming at nine.
sentences.translation: Iltimos, ertaga o'z vaqtida **kelishga harakat qiling** — mijoz soat to'qqizda keladi.

sentences.text: Firefighters **tried to save** the old library, but most of the books were destroyed.
sentences.translation: O't o'chiruvchilar eski kutubxonani **saqlab qolishga urinishdi**, lekin kitoblarning ko'pi yonib ketdi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza is **trying to lose** weight before her sister's wedding.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza opasining to'yidan oldin **ozishga harakat qilyapti**.

sentences.text: Don't **try to carry** that wardrobe on your own — you'll hurt your back.
sentences.translation: U shkafni yolg'iz **ko'tarishga urinma** — belingni shikastlaysan.

sentences.text: James **tried** hard **not to laugh** when his boss fell off the chair.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'i stuldan yiqilganda Jeyms **kulmaslikka** qattiq **harakat qildi**.

sentences.text: We've been **trying to contact** the airline all morning, but nobody answers.
sentences.translation: Ertalabdan beri aviakompaniya bilan **bog'lanishga urinyapmiz**, lekin hech kim javob bermayapti.

sentences.text: Why are you **trying to fix** the washing machine yourself? Call a technician!
sentences.translation: Nega kir yuvish mashinasini o'zing **tuzatishga urinyapsan**? Ustani chaqir!

sentences.text: Scientists are **trying to find** a cure for the disease.
sentences.translation: Olimlar bu kasallikka **davo topishga harakat qilmoqda**.

sentences.text: Aziz **tried to explain** the problem in English, but nobody understood him.
sentences.translation: Aziz muammoni inglizcha **tushuntirishga urindi**, lekin hech kim uni tushunmadi.

examples.title: **try doing**: experimenting to solve a problem
examples.description: Muammoni hal qilish uchun usulni sinab ko'rish: harakat oson, savol — u yordam beradimi. O'zbekchada «-ib ko'rmoq».

sentences.text: If your laptop is slow, **try restarting** it — that often helps.
sentences.translation: Noutbukingiz sekin ishlasa, uni **qayta yoqib ko'ring** — ko'pincha yordam beradi.

sentences.text: I couldn't sleep, so I **tried counting** sheep, but it didn't work.
sentences.translation: Uxlay olmadim, qo'y **sanab ko'rdim**, lekin foyda bermadi.

sentences.text: Have you **tried adding** a bit of lemon juice to the sauce?
sentences.translation: Sousga biroz limon sharbati **qo'shib ko'rdingizmi**?

sentences.text: The shop was closed, so we **tried ringing** the bell at the back door.
sentences.translation: Do'kon yopiq edi, shuning uchun orqa eshikdagi qo'ng'iroqni **chalib ko'rdik**.

sentences.text: Nilufar had terrible headaches until she **tried drinking** more water.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ko'proq **suv ichib ko'rmaguncha** qattiq bosh og'rig'idan qiynalgan edi.

sentences.text: **Try turning** the key the other way — the lock is a bit strange.
sentences.translation: Kalitni teskari tomonga **burab ko'ring** — qulf biroz g'alati.

sentences.text: Why don't you **try asking** Kate? She knows a lot about tax.
sentences.translation: Nega Keytdan **so'rab ko'rmaysiz**? U soliq haqida ko'p narsa biladi.

sentences.text: We **tried changing** the time of the meeting, but half the team still couldn't come.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish vaqtini **o'zgartirib ko'rdik**, lekin jamoaning yarmi baribir kela olmadi.

sentences.text: My doctor told me to **try cutting** out coffee for a couple of weeks.
sentences.translation: Shifokorim bir-ikki hafta qahvani **tashlab ko'rishni** maslahat berdi.

sentences.text: If learning words is hard, **try writing** them on cards and sticking them around the flat.
sentences.translation: So'z yodlash qiyin bo'lsa, ularni kartochkalarga **yozib**, uy bo'ylab yopishtirib **ko'ring**.

examples.title: Contrast: **try to do** or **try doing**?
examples.description: Juft gaplar: avval urinish (try to), keyin boshqa usulni sinab ko'rish (try -ing). Farqni o'zbekcha «urindim» / «-ib ko'rdim» bilan solishtiring.

sentences.text: I **tried to call** Madina, but her phone was switched off.
sentences.translation: Madinaga **qo'ng'iroq qilishga urindim**, lekin telefoni o'chiq edi.

sentences.text: When she didn't answer her mobile, I **tried calling** her office number.
sentences.translation: Uyali telefonini ko'tarmagach, ish raqamiga **qo'ng'iroq qilib ko'rdim**.

sentences.text: Sarah **tried to sleep**, but the neighbours' party was too loud.
sentences.translation: Sara **uxlashga urindi**, lekin qo'shnilarning bazmi juda shovqinli edi.

sentences.text: Sarah **tried sleeping** with earplugs, and it worked perfectly.
sentences.translation: Sara quloq tiqinlari bilan **uxlab ko'rdi** va bu juda yaxshi natija berdi.

sentences.text: The window was stuck, so I **tried to open** it with a knife.
sentences.translation: Deraza qotib qolgan edi, men uni pichoq bilan **ochishga urindim**.

sentences.text: The room was stuffy, so I **tried opening** the window, but it didn't help.
sentences.translation: Xona dim edi, men derazani **ochib ko'rdim**, lekin foydasi bo'lmadi.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is trying to learn** Spanish, but he never has enough time.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ispan tilini **o'rganishga harakat qilyapti**, lekin hech vaqti yetmaydi.

sentences.text: Have you **tried watching** Spanish films with subtitles? It really helps.
sentences.translation: Ispancha filmlarni subtitr bilan **ko'rib ko'rdingizmi**? Haqiqatan yordam beradi.

sentences.text: I **tried to remember** her name, but it had completely gone.
sentences.translation: Uning ismini **eslashga urindim**, lekin butunlay esimdan chiqib ketgan edi.

sentences.text: Next time, **try writing** people's names down as soon as you meet them.
sentences.translation: Keyingi safar odamlarning ismini tanishishingiz bilanoq **yozib qo'yib ko'ring**.

examples.title: **need to do** / **don't need to do**
examples.description: Ega o'zi biror ishni qilishi kerak (need to) yoki shart emas (don't need to). O'zbekchada «-ishim kerak», «-ishingiz shart emas».

sentences.text: I **need to renew** my passport before we go to Turkey in July.
sentences.translation: Iyulda Turkiyaga borishimizdan oldin pasportimni **yangilashim kerak**.

sentences.text: You **don't need to bring** anything — we've got plenty of food.
sentences.translation: Hech narsa **olib kelishingiz shart emas** — ovqatimiz ko'p.

sentences.text: Does Jasur **need to sign** the contract in person, or can he do it online?
sentences.translation: Jasur shartnomani shaxsan **imzolashi kerakmi** yoki onlayn qilsa bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: We **need to talk** about what happened at the meeting yesterday.
sentences.translation: Kechagi yig'ilishda nima bo'lgani haqida **gaplashib olishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Students **don't need to wear** a uniform at this school.
sentences.translation: Bu maktabda o'quvchilar **forma kiyishi shart emas**.

sentences.text: The government **needs to do** more to help small businesses.
sentences.translation: Hukumat kichik biznesga yordam berish uchun ko'proq **ish qilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: How much money do you **need to borrow**? — About two thousand pounds.
sentences.translation: Qancha pul **qarz olishingiz kerak**? — Taxminan ikki ming funt.

sentences.text: Kate **didn't need to take** a taxi — the hotel was only five minutes away.
sentences.translation: Keytning taksiga **o'tirishiga hojat yo'q edi** — mehmonxona atigi besh daqiqalik yo'lda edi.

sentences.text: Everyone **needs to switch off** their phones before the exam starts.
sentences.translation: Imtihon boshlanishidan oldin hamma **telefonini o'chirishi kerak**.

sentences.text: If you feel dizzy, you **need to sit** down and drink some water.
sentences.translation: Boshingiz aylansa, **o'tirib**, biroz suv **ichishingiz kerak**.

examples.title: **needs doing** = needs to be done
examples.description: Ega — narsa (car, shirt, roof), u nimadir qilinishga muhtoj; ma'no majhul. O'zbekchada «-ish kerak». Norasmiy Britaniya varianti — wants doing.

sentences.text: The car **needs washing** — it's covered in dust after the trip to Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Mashinani **yuvish kerak** — Buxoro safaridan keyin chang bosib ketgan.

sentences.text: This shirt **needs ironing** before the interview.
sentences.translation: Suhbatdan oldin bu ko'ylakni **dazmollash kerak**.

sentences.text: Do the plants **need watering** every day, or only twice a week?
sentences.translation: Gullarga har kuni **suv quyish kerakmi** yoki haftada ikki marta yetarlimi?

sentences.text: Our kitchen ceiling **needs painting**, but we can't afford it this year.
sentences.translation: Oshxonamizning shiftini **bo'yash kerak**, lekin bu yil bunga pulimiz yetmaydi.

sentences.text: Your hair **needs cutting** — you can hardly see!
sentences.translation: Sochingni **oldirish kerak** — ko'zing deyarli ko'rinmayapti!

sentences.text: Before it goes to the director, the report **needs checking** carefully.
sentences.translation: Hisobot direktorga borishidan oldin uni diqqat bilan **tekshirish kerak**.

sentences.text: The old bridge **needs repairing**, so it's closed to lorries.
sentences.translation: Eski ko'prikni **ta'mirlash kerak**, shuning uchun yuk mashinalari uchun yopiq.

sentences.text: I think the batteries in the smoke alarm **need changing** — it keeps beeping.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, tutun signalizatsiyasidagi batareyalarni **almashtirish kerak** — to'xtovsiz chiyillayapti.

sentences.text: Does anything else **need doing** before the guests arrive?
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar kelishidan oldin yana biror narsa **qilish kerakmi**?

sentences.text: Mum says the grass **wants cutting**, but it's been raining all week.
sentences.translation: Oyimning aytishicha, maysani **o'rish kerak**, lekin butun hafta yomg'ir yog'yapti.

examples.title: **help** (to) do, **help** somebody (to) do
examples.description: help dan keyin to ixtiyoriy: help (to) clean, help me (to) carry. O'zbekchada «-ishga yordam bermoq», «-ishimga yordam bermoq».

sentences.text: Could you **help me move** the sofa? It's too heavy for one person.
sentences.translation: Divanni **surishga yordam bera olasizmi**? Bir kishiga juda og'ir.

sentences.text: A friend of mine **helped me to find** a cheap flat near the university.
sentences.translation: Bir do'stim universitet yaqinidan arzon kvartira **topishimga yordam berdi**.

sentences.text: Regular exercise **helps reduce** stress and improve sleep.
sentences.translation: Muntazam jismoniy mashqlar stressni **kamaytirishga** va uyquni yaxshilashga **yordam beradi**.

sentences.text: Everybody **helped to clean up** after the party, so it only took twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Ziyofatdan keyin hamma **yig'ishtirishga yordam berdi**, shuning uchun atigi yigirma daqiqa ketdi.

sentences.text: Can you **help Grandma carry** her bags up the stairs?
sentences.translation: Buvimga sumkalarini zinadan **olib chiqishga yordam berib yubora olasanmi**?

sentences.text: The new software will **help us to keep** track of our orders.
sentences.translation: Yangi dastur buyurtmalarimizni **kuzatib borishga yordam beradi**.

sentences.text: Talking to a counsellor **helped Oliver deal** with the stress of his divorce.
sentences.translation: Psixolog bilan suhbat Oliverga ajrimdan keyingi stress bilan **kurashishga yordam berdi**.

sentences.text: Learning a second language **can help children develop** a better memory.
sentences.translation: Ikkinchi tilni o'rganish bolalarning xotirasi **yaxshi rivojlanishiga yordam berishi mumkin**.

sentences.text: Who **helped you write** this speech? It's really good.
sentences.translation: Bu nutqni **yozishingizga** kim **yordam berdi**? Juda zo'r chiqibdi.

sentences.text: My teacher **helped me to prepare** for the IELTS exam by giving me extra lessons.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchim qo'shimcha darslar berib, IELTS imtihoniga **tayyorlanishimga yordam berdi**.

examples.title: **can't help doing**: I couldn't help laughing
examples.description: can't / couldn't help -ing — o'zini tuta olmaslik, beixtiyor qilib qo'yish. I can't help it — «ilojim yo'q». can't help feeling / thinking — «... degan fikrdan qutula olmayman».

sentences.text: I **couldn't help laughing** when the cat jumped onto the table in the middle of the video call.
sentences.translation: Video qo'ng'iroq o'rtasida mushuk stol ustiga sakraganda, o'zimni tutolmay **kulib yubordim**.

sentences.text: Madina **can't help worrying** about her son when he drives at night.
sentences.translation: O'g'li kechasi mashina haydasa, Madina **xavotirlanmasdan qila olmaydi**.

sentences.text: Sorry, I **couldn't help overhearing** your conversation — are you from Samarkand too?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, suhbatingizni **beixtiyor eshitib qoldim** — siz ham Samarqanddanmisiz?

sentences.text: Bekzod **can't help eating** sweets when he's stressed.
sentences.translation: Bekzod asabiylashganda **shirinlik yemasdan turolmaydi**.

sentences.text: I **can't help feeling** that we've made a big mistake.
sentences.translation: Katta xato qildik, **degan fikrdan qutula olmayapman**.

sentences.text: She **couldn't help smiling** when she saw her old school friends.
sentences.translation: Eski maktabdoshlarini ko'rib, u **beixtiyor jilmaydi**.

sentences.text: I'm sorry I'm late — I **couldn't help it**, the metro broke down.
sentences.translation: Kechikkanim uchun uzr — **ilojim yo'q edi**, metro buzilib qoldi.

sentences.text: Visitors to Khiva **can't help noticing** how well the old city has been preserved.
sentences.translation: Xivaga kelganlar eski shahar qanchalik yaxshi saqlanganini **sezmay qolmaydi**.

sentences.text: Tom **couldn't help thinking** about the job offer all through dinner.
sentences.translation: Tom kechki ovqat davomida ish taklifi haqida **o'ylamasdan turolmadi**.

sentences.text: Don't blame him for crying — he **can't help it**, he's only three.
sentences.translation: Yig'lagani uchun uni ayblama — u **o'zini tutolmaydi**, hali atigi uch yoshda.

examples.title: Dialogue: fixing up an old flat
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: eski kvartirani ta'mirlash haqida suhbat — needs doing, try to / try -ing, need to, help, can't help.

sentences.text: — Welcome to our new flat! Almost everything here **needs repairing**.
sentences.translation: — Yangi kvartiramizga xush kelibsiz! Bu yerda deyarli hamma narsani **ta'mirlash kerak**.

sentences.text: — I can see that. Have you **tried cleaning** these walls, or do they **need painting**?
sentences.translation: — Ko'rib turibman. Bu devorlarni **tozalab ko'rdingizmi** yoki ularni **bo'yash kerakmi**?

sentences.text: — We **tried to wash** them, but the marks wouldn't come off.
sentences.translation: — **Yuvishga urindik**, lekin dog'lar ketmadi.

sentences.text: — Then you definitely **need to buy** some paint. I can **help you choose** the colour.
sentences.translation: — Unda albatta bo'yoq **sotib olishingiz kerak**. Rangni **tanlashga yordam beraman**.

sentences.text: — Thanks! And the kitchen tap keeps dripping — Aziz is **trying to fix** it now.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! Oshxonadagi jo'mrak ham tomchilayapti — Aziz hozir uni **tuzatishga urinyapti**.

sentences.text: — Has he **tried changing** the rubber washer inside? That usually works.
sentences.translation: — Ichidagi rezina qistirmani **almashtirib ko'rdimi**? Odatda shu yordam beradi.

sentences.text: — I don't know. To be honest, I **can't help thinking** we should call a plumber.
sentences.translation: — Bilmadim. Rostini aytsam, santexnik chaqirsak kerak, **degan fikr xayolimdan ketmayapti**.

sentences.text: — You **don't need to pay** a plumber — my brother can do it for free.
sentences.translation: — Santexnikka **pul to'lashingiz shart emas** — akam bepul qilib beradi.

sentences.text: — That would **help** us **save** a lot of money. Can he come on Saturday?
sentences.translation: — Bu bizga ancha pul **tejashga yordam beradi**. U shanba kuni kela oladimi?

sentences.text: — I'll **try to persuade** him, but he **needs reminding** about everything!
sentences.translation: — **Ko'ndirishga harakat qilaman**, lekin unga har narsani **eslatib turish kerak**!
